description: This file contains source code implementing functions for parsing various JSON-based request types, forming responses, and mapping status codes within a testing stub for the WDMP protocol. It includes functions to handle get, set, attribute, table, add, delete, and test-and-set requests, as well as to generate corresponding JSON responses.

methods.name: void parse_get_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for a get operation, filling a request structure based on parameters and attributes.

methods.name: void parse_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for a set operation, extracting parameter names, values, and types into a request structure.

methods.name: void parse_set_attr_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for setting attributes on parameters, including notification settings.

methods.name: void parse_test_and_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for a test-and-set operation, including old and new CIDs and parameters.

methods.name: void parse_replace_rows_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to replace multiple rows in a table.

methods.name: void parse_add_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to add a new row to a table.

methods.name: void parse_delete_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to delete a specific row from a table.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_get_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for a get request, including parameter values and status message.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_get_attr_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for a get attribute request, including attributes like notify.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_set_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for a set request, indicating success or failure per parameter.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_table_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response after table row operations such as add or replace.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_test_and_set_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for test-and-set operations, including synced CID and CMC attributes.

methods.name: void mapWdmpStatusToStatusMessage(WDMP_STATUS status,char * result)
methods.description: Converts WDMP status codes to human-readable status messages.

methods.name: void getStatusCode(WDMP_RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE * statusCode,int paramCount,WDMP_STATUS * ret)
methods.description: Determines the overall response status code based on individual parameter statuses.

ctags.name: getStatusCode
ctags.pattern: /^ void getStatusCode(WDMP_RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE *statusCode, int paramCount, WDMP_STATUS * ret)$/
